[b]The Invitation | Second Flouesch Republic | Erene 2000[/b]

[b][sub]Official notice of the request of a state visit of Rosenmarkke, Vespurias, and the Government of the Confederal Kingdom of Floueschia in Vespurias to the Second Flouesch Republic  [/sub][/b]

From: Secretary of Forigen Affairs, Dr. Christian Welter

To my dear compatriots and counterparts in the Republic of Rosenmarkke and the Commonwealth of Vespurias. And to the gentlemen in charge of the forigen affairs of the royalist government in exile. I hope this letter finds you well.

As all of our nations have come to be good friends on the international stage, united in a clear vision for the future of Erene. The government of the Second Flouesch Republic would like to request a formal state visit by the heads of state of your respective natons be made to the Second Flouesch Republic to strengthen trilateral relations between our nations. The meeting will be held in Republik Haus, the residence of the incumbent First Consul, Friedrich Müller, which is located in Téiernsbuer. Dinner, protection, and a tour of the city will be offered at our expense. 

Most sincerely, Secretariat of Forigen Affairs, Dr. Christian Welter, 

[b]Fräiheet, Fridden, Brout a Rosen![/b]

[nation]Vespurias[/nation]
[nation]The Crystalline Empire[/nation]

[quote=nederlandse_staat;61177977][Spoiler=defensive but destructive][I]Klaas clicks his tongue, leans against the chair and responds to mr. T, "The royal navy is currently restricted to their ports because the HDF is much larger then our fleet and strikes any warship who tries to pass. Only our submarines can get past and they are always patrolling the south Vespurian coast for HochDeutsche supply ships to sink. But the AAO created something that might wreck entire divisions if done right." An AAO agent, the same who escorted mr. T from the airport, grabs a cup of tea from a shelf and places it on the desk in the room and Klaas starts to explain, "see this? This isn't actually tea but 90,5% ABV. Almost pure alcohol. Several flavours and some water is added to this mix to make it look like tea but it can also be mixed to make it look like other substances. This drink can cause dangerous intoxication that can lead to cognitive fog, slower reaction time, impaired coordination and other things because of alcohol's negative consequences. It can destroy a small army but i suggest being careful with it because if it makes it way into large water reservoirs it can affect large amounts of civilians and cause massive damage which is not one of my goals. I suggest to find any weaknesses in the supply lines of Daesun and NeuDresden and flood their supply with this drink once they do something major. That way soldiers are less effective in combat and can be defeated. but, we won't use this drink for the time. It Will only be a defensive measure. "
Klaas shoves the cup away and looks straight at mr. T, "For the thing about the daesun navy, our navy is held up by NeuDresden. But i can suggest to target Daesun's supply ships, repair yards and any ports that can hold their warships. You should also use cheap drones to make them waste ammo and missiles on something that can be build for 400 balion pounds or less. An AAO agent will accompany your entourage back to Balion to help your army with developing guerilla tactics and ways to undermine Daesun but.." Klaas stands up and walks to a shelf. "Don't be surprised about the agent's suggestions. They always try to break the rules of conventional warfare and we hardly have control over what they are planning behind the scenes." Klaas glances up at the ceiling, "Now the question...how do we get the money to do war and hire mercenaries?"[/i][/spoiler][/quote]
Mr T replies with; 

"On second thoughts, I think we'll rescind the volunteers to your nation. It is logistically impossible to gather up 50k potential expats and deliver them to this nation under the already heavy opposition. In addition, we do not want an entire alliance against us like what you have ended up having. So it is best that we do not engage in hostile action with any nation besides the Gaesunians."

"But going back to the this offer, I also suggest that before partaking in such a deadly endeavour we must act in a honourable way and to first engage in negotiations to settle for peace. If that is not done to a satisfactory manner, then we can engage in destroying their waters and water supply. Yes that idea of very strong alcohol that looks like tea is very smart, I'd also suggest adding in tiny amounts of lead and mercury to make it even more deadlier. I also propose the idea of sending in sleeper agents into Gaesun for intelligence gathering.... [i]and to do a little trolling[/i]"

It is then negotiated that the AAO agent will be sent to Empire Island to help train and guide the conscripted Imperial Brigades. It is also requested that another AAO agent be sent to help the local militia and police in the Northwest Frontier to help fight against Raffordic guerrillas. Along with that, shared designs of cheap but effective drones to be given to the Dutch state along with partial Balionic private sector funding and ownership of Dutch factories that will be vital for infrastructure and the military industry.
